description: This file defines the SocketSchedulers class, which manages a collection of PipeScheduler instances for socket I/O operations, selecting an appropriate scheduler based on configuration options or default thread pool schedulers.

classes.name: SocketSchedulers
classes.description: Manages an array of PipeScheduler instances to distribute socket I/O workload, either based on a configured IOQueueCount or default thread pool schedulers.

methods.name: SocketSchedulers
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scheduler array based on the provided SocketConnectionOptions, either creating IOQueue instances or defaulting to thread pool schedulers.

methods.name: GetScheduler
methods.description: Returns the next PipeScheduler in a round-robin fashion from the internal scheduler array.
